name: FNaF Sister Location: Custom Night PSP
author: technicaljicama
description: A remake of the sister location custom night for the Sony PSP written in c++. Currently, not all features are implemented (due to limited time for the game jam) but the game is playable and fun! Expect a few bugs and crashes (please report them here) Notes: A 3ds port will be developed soon! The code will be made open source! It will not work on a psp 1000 Controls: Cross (X) = Interact on the cams, click on bonnet, confirm R trigger (right shoulder button) = Open cam tablet DPAD Left = Move to the next cam on the left, select character in custom night. DPAD Right = Move to the next cam on the right, select character in custom night. DPAD Down = Decrease the character's level in the custom night menu. DPAD UP = Increase the character's level in the custom night menu. Square = Open/close left door Circle = Open/close right door Triangle = Open/close vent
